name: ClunoGS Unified Optimization
aliases: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
definition: The method represents N initial Gaussians with opacity vector o and continuous per-Gaussian attributes Θ (color coefficients, higher-order spherical harmonic coefficients, scale, rotation, and semantic coefficient values). 3D positions and scene-level semantic dictionaries remain in full precision.
summary: ClunoGS Unified Optimization jointly optimizes Gaussian parameters, sparsity, and vector quantization to reduce storage and computational cost while preserving semantic fidelity in Language 3D Gaussian Splatting.
